reason: Main method was intraday scalping of S&P e-mini futures (short side only) using spoofing/layering algorithms during volatile down moves.

setup.rule: Trade during high volatility falling markets
setup.quote: Navs strategy was principally to go short the market in a falling market and then get out quickly and keep getting in and out you know during highly volatile periods when markets were falling

entry.rule: Place spoof sell orders then enter genuine short
entry.quote: simultaneously to doing that he would also be just shorting the market waiting for it to go down a couple of ticks and then exiting his position

exits.rule: Exit after a few ticks profit
exits.quote: he would just get in and out after a few ticks

sizing.rule: Scale up size aggressively with profits
sizing.quote: his ability to just keep upping size and continually take on more and more risk

market_filter.quote: during highly volatile periods when markets were falling

ambiguities.issue: No concrete long-only US stock rules provided
ambiguities.assumption: Method is futures scalping and therefore outside scope
